en.front: Ask: "Where did you spot a number today?"
en.back: Numbers are everywhere — a bus number, a price tag, a clock. Let your child point one out and say what it means. There's no wrong answer.

en-GB.front: Ask: "Where did you spot a number today?"
en-GB.back: Numbers are everywhere — a bus number, a price tag, a clock. Let your child point one out and say what it means. There's no wrong answer.

de-CH.front: Frage: "Wo hast du heute eine Zahl entdeckt?"
de-CH.back: Zahlen sind ueberall — eine Busnummer, ein Preisschild, eine Uhr. Lass dein Kind eine zeigen und erklaeren, was sie bedeutet. Es gibt keine falsche Antwort.

fr-CH.front: Demande : "Ou as-tu repere un nombre aujourd'hui ?"
fr-CH.back: Les nombres sont partout — un numero de bus, une etiquette de prix, une horloge. Laisse ton enfant en montrer un et expliquer ce qu'il signifie. Il n'y a pas de mauvaise reponse.

it-CH.front: Chiedi: "Dove hai visto un numero oggi?"
it-CH.back: I numeri sono ovunque — un numero di autobus, un cartellino del prezzo, un orologio. Lascia che tuo figlio ne indichi uno e spieghi cosa significa. Non c'e una risposta sbagliata.

en.front: Ask: "What's your favourite number and why?"
en.back: This isn't a maths test — it opens a relaxed chat about numbers and often reveals what your child finds interesting, or tricky.

en-GB.front: Ask: "What's your favourite number and why?"
en-GB.back: This isn't a maths test — it opens a relaxed chat about numbers and often reveals what your child finds interesting, or tricky.

de-CH.front: Frage: "Was ist deine Lieblingszahl und warum?"
de-CH.back: Das ist kein Mathetest — es eroeffnet ein entspanntes Gespraech ueber Zahlen und zeigt oft, was dein Kind spannend oder schwierig findet.

fr-CH.front: Demande : "Quel est ton nombre prefere et pourquoi ?"
fr-CH.back: Ce n'est pas un test de maths — cela ouvre une discussion detendue sur les nombres et revele souvent ce que ton enfant trouve interessant, ou difficile.

it-CH.front: Chiedi: "Qual e il tuo numero preferito e perche?"
it-CH.back: Non e un test di matematica — apre una chiacchierata rilassata sui numeri e spesso rivela cosa tuo figlio trova interessante, o difficile.

en.front: Stuck? Ask them to explain it to you first.
en.back: Before jumping in with the answer, ask your child to talk you through what they've already tried. Explaining out loud often unlocks the next step on its own.

en-GB.front: Stuck? Ask them to explain it to you first.
en-GB.back: Before jumping in with the answer, ask your child to talk you through what they've already tried. Explaining out loud often unlocks the next step on its own.

de-CH.front: Haengt fest? Lass es dir zuerst erklaeren.
de-CH.back: Bevor du die Loesung vorgibst, lass dein Kind erzaehlen, was es schon versucht hat. Laut erklaeren loest oft den naechsten Schritt von selbst aus.

fr-CH.front: Bloque ? Demande-lui de t'expliquer d'abord.
fr-CH.back: Avant de donner la reponse, demande a ton enfant de t'expliquer ce qu'il a deja essaye. Expliquer a voix haute debloque souvent l'etape suivante toute seule.

it-CH.front: Bloccato? Fatti spiegare prima da lui.
it-CH.back: Prima di dare la risposta, chiedi a tuo figlio di raccontarti cosa ha gia provato. Spiegare ad alta voce spesso sblocca da solo il passo successivo.

en.front: It's OK to say "let's find out together."
en.back: You don't need to know the answer. Modelling how to check notes, a textbook, or work it out step by step is more valuable than always knowing everything yourself.

en-GB.front: It's OK to say "let's find out together."
en-GB.back: You don't need to know the answer. Modelling how to check notes, a textbook, or work it out step by step is more valuable than always knowing everything yourself.

de-CH.front: Es ist in Ordnung zu sagen: "Lass uns das gemeinsam herausfinden."
de-CH.back: Du musst die Antwort nicht kennen. Zu zeigen, wie man Notizen, ein Buch nachschlaegt oder Schritt fuer Schritt vorgeht, ist wertvoller, als immer alles zu wissen.

fr-CH.front: C'est normal de dire : "cherchons ensemble."
fr-CH.back: Tu n'as pas besoin de connaitre la reponse. Montrer comment verifier ses notes, un manuel, ou raisonner etape par etape est plus utile que de tout savoir soi-meme.

it-CH.front: Va benissimo dire: "scopriamolo insieme."
it-CH.back: Non devi conoscere la risposta. Mostrare come controllare gli appunti, un libro, o ragionare passo dopo passo vale piu che sapere sempre tutto tu.

en.front: Halve or double a recipe together.
en.back: Cooking for more or fewer people is real fraction and ratio practice. Ask: "If this needs 2 eggs for 4 people, how many for 8?"

en-GB.front: Halve or double a recipe together.
en-GB.back: Cooking for more or fewer people is real fraction and ratio practice. Ask: "If this needs 2 eggs for 4 people, how many for 8?"

de-CH.front: Halbiert oder verdoppelt gemeinsam ein Rezept.
de-CH.back: Fuer mehr oder weniger Personen zu kochen ist echte Bruch- und Verhaeltnisuebung. Frage: "Wenn das 2 Eier fuer 4 Personen braucht, wie viele fuer 8?"

fr-CH.front: Divise ou double une recette ensemble.
fr-CH.back: Cuisiner pour plus ou moins de personnes, c'est un vrai exercice de fractions et de proportions. Demande : "S'il faut 2 oeufs pour 4 personnes, combien pour 8 ?"

it-CH.front: Dimezza o raddoppia una ricetta insieme.
it-CH.back: Cucinare per piu o meno persone e un vero esercizio di frazioni e proporzioni. Chiedi: "Se servono 2 uova per 4 persone, quante per 8?"

en.front: Set a timer and estimate first.
en.back: Before starting the microwave or oven timer, ask your child to guess how long something will take, then compare their guess to the real time.

en-GB.front: Set a timer and estimate first.
en-GB.back: Before starting the microwave or oven timer, ask your child to guess how long something will take, then compare their guess to the real time.

de-CH.front: Stellt einen Timer, aber schaetzt zuerst.
de-CH.back: Bevor du die Mikrowelle oder den Ofen startest, lass dein Kind schaetzen, wie lange es dauert, und vergleicht danach mit der echten Zeit.

fr-CH.front: Regle un minuteur, mais estime d'abord.
fr-CH.back: Avant de lancer le micro-ondes ou le four, demande a ton enfant de deviner combien de temps cela prendra, puis compare avec le temps reel.

it-CH.front: Imposta un timer, ma prima stima il tempo.
it-CH.back: Prima di avviare il microonde o il forno, chiedi a tuo figlio di indovinare quanto tempo servira, poi confrontate con il tempo reale.

en.front: Let them find the better value.
en.back: Compare two sizes of the same product in a shop or online. Which costs less per 100g? A calculator is fine — the thinking matters more than mental arithmetic.

en-GB.front: Let them find the better value.
en-GB.back: Compare two sizes of the same product in a shop or online. Which costs less per 100g? A calculator is fine — the thinking matters more than mental arithmetic.

de-CH.front: Lass dein Kind das bessere Angebot finden.
de-CH.back: Vergleicht zwei Groessen desselben Produkts im Laden oder online. Was kostet weniger pro 100g? Ein Taschenrechner ist erlaubt — das Denken zaehlt mehr als Kopfrechnen.

fr-CH.front: Laisse-le trouver la meilleure affaire.
fr-CH.back: Comparez deux tailles du meme produit en magasin ou en ligne. Lequel coute moins cher pour 100g ? Une calculatrice, c'est permis — le raisonnement compte plus que le calcul mental.

it-CH.front: Fagli trovare l'offerta migliore.
it-CH.back: Confrontate due formati dello stesso prodotto in negozio o online. Quale costa meno per 100g? Va bene usare una calcolatrice — conta il ragionamento, non il calcolo a mente.

en.front: Estimate the total before you pay.
en.back: As you add items to a trolley or basket, ask your child to keep a rough running total. Checking against the receipt afterwards makes it a game, not a test.

en-GB.front: Estimate the total before you pay.
en-GB.back: As you add items to a trolley or basket, ask your child to keep a rough running total. Checking against the receipt afterwards makes it a game, not a test.

de-CH.front: Schaetzt die Summe, bevor ihr bezahlt.
de-CH.back: Waehrend ihr Sachen in den Wagen oder Korb legt, soll dein Kind ungefaehr mitzaehlen. Der Vergleich mit der Quittung danach macht daraus ein Spiel, keinen Test.

fr-CH.front: Estime le total avant de payer.
fr-CH.back: Pendant que vous remplissez le chariot ou le panier, demande a ton enfant de garder un total approximatif. Comparer avec le ticket de caisse en fait un jeu, pas un test.

it-CH.front: Stima il totale prima di pagare.
it-CH.back: Mentre riempite il carrello o il cestino, chiedi a tuo figlio di tenere un totale approssimativo. Confrontarlo con lo scontrino dopo lo trasforma in un gioco, non in una verifica.

en.front: Turn a family rule into an equation.
en.back: "Everyone gets £5 pocket money plus £1 per chore" can be written as p = 5 + c. Ask how much pocket money for 3 chores — that's algebra, no worksheet needed.

en-GB.front: Turn a family rule into an equation.
en-GB.back: "Everyone gets £5 pocket money plus £1 per chore" can be written as p = 5 + c. Ask how much pocket money for 3 chores — that's algebra, no worksheet needed.

de-CH.front: Macht aus einer Familienregel eine Gleichung.
de-CH.back: "Jeder bekommt 5 Franken Taschengeld plus 1 Franken pro Aufgabe" laesst sich als t = 5 + a schreiben. Frage, wie viel Taschengeld bei 3 Aufgaben — das ist Algebra, ganz ohne Arbeitsblatt.

fr-CH.front: Transforme une regle familiale en equation.
fr-CH.back: "Chacun recoit 5 francs d'argent de poche plus 1 franc par tache" s'ecrit a = 5 + t. Demande combien d'argent de poche pour 3 taches — c'est de l'algebre, sans feuille d'exercices.

it-CH.front: Trasforma una regola di famiglia in un'equazione.
it-CH.back: "Ognuno riceve 5 franchi di paghetta piu 1 franco per faccenda" si scrive p = 5 + f. Chiedi quanta paghetta per 3 faccende — e algebra, senza nessuna scheda.

en.front: Ask "what's the missing number?" out loud.
en.back: "I bought something and now have £7 left from £20 — how much did I spend?" is exactly the same skill as solving 20 − x = 7, just without the letters.

en-GB.front: Ask "what's the missing number?" out loud.
en-GB.back: "I bought something and now have £7 left from £20 — how much did I spend?" is exactly the same skill as solving 20 − x = 7, just without the letters.

de-CH.front: Frage laut: "Welche Zahl fehlt?"
de-CH.back: "Ich habe etwas gekauft und habe noch 7 Franken von 20 uebrig — wie viel habe ich ausgegeben?" ist genau dieselbe Faehigkeit wie 20 − x = 7 zu loesen, nur ohne Buchstaben.

fr-CH.front: Demande a voix haute : "quel est le nombre manquant ?"
fr-CH.back: "J'ai achete quelque chose et il me reste 7 francs sur 20 — combien ai-je depense ?" demande exactement la meme competence que resoudre 20 − x = 7, sans les lettres.

it-CH.front: Chiedi ad alta voce: "qual e il numero mancante?"
it-CH.back: "Ho comprato qualcosa e mi restano 7 franchi su 20 — quanto ho speso?" richiede esattamente la stessa abilita di risolvere 20 − x = 7, solo senza le lettere.

en.front: Spot a shape and name its properties.
en.back: Pick an object — a door, a plate, a road sign — and ask how many sides, corners, or lines of symmetry it has. Real objects make abstract shape vocabulary stick.

en-GB.front: Spot a shape and name its properties.
en-GB.back: Pick an object — a door, a plate, a road sign — and ask how many sides, corners, or lines of symmetry it has. Real objects make abstract shape vocabulary stick.

de-CH.front: Entdeckt eine Form und benennt ihre Eigenschaften.
de-CH.back: Waehlt einen Gegenstand — eine Tuer, einen Teller, ein Verkehrsschild — und fragt, wie viele Seiten, Ecken oder Symmetrieachsen er hat. Echte Objekte machen abstrakte Begriffe greifbar.

fr-CH.front: Repere une forme et nomme ses proprietes.
fr-CH.back: Choisissez un objet — une porte, une assiette, un panneau routier — et demande combien de cotes, de coins ou d'axes de symetrie il a. Les objets reels font retenir le vocabulaire des formes.

it-CH.front: Individua una forma e nominane le proprieta.
it-CH.back: Scegliete un oggetto — una porta, un piatto, un cartello stradale — e chiedi quanti lati, angoli o assi di simmetria ha. Gli oggetti reali fanno ricordare il vocabolario delle forme.

en.front: Measure a room together before rearranging furniture.
en.back: Working out if a piece of furniture will fit is real-world area and perimeter — no textbook required, and the result actually matters to your child.

en-GB.front: Measure a room together before rearranging furniture.
en-GB.back: Working out if a piece of furniture will fit is real-world area and perimeter — no textbook required, and the result actually matters to your child.

de-CH.front: Messt gemeinsam ein Zimmer aus, bevor ihr Moebel umstellt.
de-CH.back: Herauszufinden, ob ein Moebelstueck passt, ist echte Flaechen- und Umfangberechnung — ganz ohne Lehrbuch, und das Ergebnis ist deinem Kind wirklich wichtig.

fr-CH.front: Mesurez une piece ensemble avant de deplacer les meubles.
fr-CH.back: Determiner si un meuble va rentrer, c'est du calcul d'aire et de perimetre bien reel — sans manuel, et le resultat compte vraiment pour ton enfant.

it-CH.front: Misurate insieme una stanza prima di spostare i mobili.
it-CH.back: Capire se un mobile ci sta e un vero calcolo di area e perimetro — senza libro di testo, e il risultato conta davvero per tuo figlio.

en.front: Play "guess my number" on a car or bus journey.
en.back: Think of a number 1–100. Your child asks yes/no questions ("Is it more than 50?") to narrow it down — a fun way to practise number sense and logical thinking.

en-GB.front: Play "guess my number" on a car or bus journey.
en-GB.back: Think of a number 1–100. Your child asks yes/no questions ("Is it more than 50?") to narrow it down — a fun way to practise number sense and logical thinking.

de-CH.front: Spielt "Zahlenraten" im Auto oder Bus.
de-CH.back: Denk dir eine Zahl zwischen 1 und 100. Dein Kind stellt Ja/Nein-Fragen ("Ist sie groesser als 50?"), um sie einzugrenzen — eine unterhaltsame Uebung fuer Zahlengefuehl und logisches Denken.

fr-CH.front: Joue a "devine mon nombre" en voiture ou en bus.
fr-CH.back: Pense a un nombre entre 1 et 100. Ton enfant pose des questions oui/non ("Est-ce plus que 50 ?") pour le trouver — une facon amusante de travailler le sens du nombre et la logique.

it-CH.front: Giocate a "indovina il mio numero" in auto o in autobus.
it-CH.back: Pensa a un numero tra 1 e 100. Tuo figlio fa domande si/no ("E piu di 50?") per restringere il campo — un modo divertente per allenare il senso del numero e la logica.

en.front: Count down together instead of up.
en.back: Try counting backwards in 3s or 7s from 100. It's genuinely harder than counting up and builds real fluency with number bonds.

en-GB.front: Count down together instead of up.
en-GB.back: Try counting backwards in 3s or 7s from 100. It's genuinely harder than counting up and builds real fluency with number bonds.

de-CH.front: Zaehlt gemeinsam rueckwaerts statt vorwaerts.
de-CH.back: Versucht, von 100 in 3er- oder 7er-Schritten rueckwaerts zu zaehlen. Das ist wirklich schwieriger als vorwaerts und staerkt das Gefuehl fuer Zahlenbeziehungen.

fr-CH.front: Comptez a rebours ensemble, pas en avant.
fr-CH.back: Essayez de compter a rebours de 3 en 3 ou de 7 en 7 depuis 100. C'est vraiment plus difficile que compter en avant et renforce la maitrise des relations entre nombres.

it-CH.front: Contate insieme all'indietro, non in avanti.
it-CH.back: Provate a contare all'indietro di 3 in 3 o di 7 in 7 da 100. E davvero piu difficile che contare in avanti e rafforza davvero la padronanza delle relazioni tra numeri.

en.front: Give a small budget for one decision.
en.back: Let your child choose between two options within a fixed amount — snacks for a trip, or how to spend birthday money. Real trade-offs teach budgeting better than any worksheet.

en-GB.front: Give a small budget for one decision.
en-GB.back: Let your child choose between two options within a fixed amount — snacks for a trip, or how to spend birthday money. Real trade-offs teach budgeting better than any worksheet.

de-CH.front: Gib fuer eine Entscheidung ein kleines Budget vor.
de-CH.back: Lass dein Kind zwischen zwei Optionen innerhalb eines festen Betrags waehlen — Snacks fuer einen Ausflug, oder wie das Geburtstagsgeld ausgegeben wird. Echte Abwaegungen lehren Budgetieren besser als jedes Arbeitsblatt.

fr-CH.front: Donne un petit budget pour une decision.
fr-CH.back: Laisse ton enfant choisir entre deux options avec un montant fixe — des collations pour une sortie, ou comment depenser l'argent d'anniversaire. Les vrais compromis enseignent mieux la gestion du budget qu'une feuille d'exercices.

it-CH.front: Dai un piccolo budget per una decisione.
it-CH.back: Lascia che tuo figlio scelga tra due opzioni con un importo fisso — snack per una gita, o come spendere i soldi del compleanno. I compromessi reali insegnano a gestire un budget meglio di qualsiasi scheda.

en.front: Track one week of pocket money together.
en.back: A simple notebook or shared note: what came in, what went out, what's left. Seeing the numbers change over days makes budgeting concrete.

en-GB.front: Track one week of pocket money together.
en-GB.back: A simple notebook or shared note: what came in, what went out, what's left. Seeing the numbers change over days makes budgeting concrete.

de-CH.front: Verfolgt gemeinsam eine Woche Taschengeld.
de-CH.back: Ein einfaches Heft oder eine gemeinsame Notiz: was reinkam, was rausging, was uebrig ist. Die Zahlen ueber Tage veraendern zu sehen macht Budgetieren greifbar.

fr-CH.front: Suivez ensemble une semaine d'argent de poche.
fr-CH.back: Un simple carnet ou une note partagee : ce qui rentre, ce qui sort, ce qui reste. Voir les chiffres changer au fil des jours rend la gestion du budget concrete.

it-CH.front: Tracciate insieme una settimana di paghetta.
it-CH.back: Un semplice quaderno o una nota condivisa: cosa entra, cosa esce, cosa resta. Vedere i numeri cambiare giorno dopo giorno rende concreto il concetto di budget.

en.front: Guess before you measure.
en.back: How tall is the fridge? How long is the sofa? Estimate together first, then check with a tape measure — the gap between guess and reality is where the learning happens.

en-GB.front: Guess before you measure.
en-GB.back: How tall is the fridge? How long is the sofa? Estimate together first, then check with a tape measure — the gap between guess and reality is where the learning happens.

de-CH.front: Schaetzt, bevor ihr messt.
de-CH.back: Wie hoch ist der Kuehlschrank? Wie lang ist das Sofa? Schaetzt zuerst gemeinsam, dann mit dem Massband nachmessen — im Unterschied zwischen Schaetzung und Realitaet steckt das Lernen.

fr-CH.front: Devine avant de mesurer.
fr-CH.back: Quelle est la hauteur du frigo ? Quelle est la longueur du canape ? Estimez d'abord ensemble, puis verifiez avec un metre — c'est dans l'ecart entre l'estimation et la realite que se trouve l'apprentissage.

it-CH.front: Indovina prima di misurare.
it-CH.back: Quant'e alto il frigorifero? Quant'e lungo il divano? Stimate prima insieme, poi verificate con un metro — l'apprendimento sta proprio nel divario tra la stima e la realta.

en.front: Compare using everyday units.
en.back: "This table is about 3 hand-spans wide" is a genuine measurement skill — estimating with a familiar unit before reaching for a ruler.

en-GB.front: Compare using everyday units.
en-GB.back: "This table is about 3 hand-spans wide" is a genuine measurement skill — estimating with a familiar unit before reaching for a ruler.

de-CH.front: Vergleicht mit Alltagsmassen.
de-CH.back: "Dieser Tisch ist etwa 3 Handspannen breit" ist eine echte Messfaehigkeit — mit einer vertrauten Einheit schaetzen, bevor man zum Lineal greift.

fr-CH.front: Compare avec des unites du quotidien.
fr-CH.back: "Cette table fait environ 3 empans de large" est une vraie competence de mesure — estimer avec une unite familiere avant de prendre une regle.

it-CH.front: Confronta usando unita quotidiane.
it-CH.back: "Questo tavolo e largo circa 3 spanne" e una vera abilita di misura — stimare con un'unita familiare prima di prendere un righello.

en.front: Work out arrival time together before a trip.
en.back: "We're leaving at 2pm and it takes 45 minutes — what time will we arrive?" is real speed-distance-time thinking, dressed as trip planning.

en-GB.front: Work out arrival time together before a trip.
en-GB.back: "We're leaving at 2pm and it takes 45 minutes — what time will we arrive?" is real speed-distance-time thinking, dressed as trip planning.

de-CH.front: Berechnet vor einer Reise gemeinsam die Ankunftszeit.
de-CH.back: "Wir fahren um 14 Uhr los und es dauert 45 Minuten — wann kommen wir an?" ist echtes Denken in Geschwindigkeit-Strecke-Zeit, verpackt als Reiseplanung.

fr-CH.front: Calculez ensemble l'heure d'arrivee avant un trajet.
fr-CH.back: "On part a 14h et ca prend 45 minutes — a quelle heure arrivera-t-on ?" est un vrai raisonnement vitesse-distance-temps, deguise en planification de voyage.

it-CH.front: Calcolate insieme l'orario di arrivo prima di un viaggio.
it-CH.back: "Partiamo alle 14 e ci vogliono 45 minuti — a che ora arriviamo?" e un vero ragionamento su velocita, distanza e tempo, travestito da pianificazione di viaggio.

en.front: Read a map or app and estimate distance.
en.back: Ask your child to spot the distance to your destination and guess how long it'll take at walking or driving speed — a natural way to connect numbers to the real world.

en-GB.front: Read a map or app and estimate distance.
en-GB.back: Ask your child to spot the distance to your destination and guess how long it'll take at walking or driving speed — a natural way to connect numbers to the real world.

de-CH.front: Lest gemeinsam eine Karte oder App und schaetzt die Distanz.
de-CH.back: Lass dein Kind die Entfernung zum Ziel finden und schaetzen, wie lange es zu Fuss oder mit dem Auto dauert — eine natuerliche Verbindung von Zahlen zur echten Welt.

fr-CH.front: Lisez une carte ou une appli et estimez la distance.
fr-CH.back: Demande a ton enfant de reperer la distance jusqu'a la destination et de deviner combien de temps cela prendra a pied ou en voiture — une facon naturelle de relier les nombres au monde reel.

it-CH.front: Leggete insieme una mappa o un'app e stimate la distanza.
it-CH.back: Chiedi a tuo figlio di individuare la distanza dalla destinazione e indovinare quanto tempo ci vorra a piedi o in auto — un modo naturale per collegare i numeri al mondo reale.
